mapper.select: select r.id, r.refund_no, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.member_id, r.merchant_id, r.refund_amount, r.status, r.reason, r.payout_status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.platform_takeover_at from refund_application r where r.status = 0 and r.del_flag = 0 and r.merchant_id is not null and r.merchant_id > 0 and r.platform_takeover_at is null and r.create_time is not null and r.create_time <= #{cutoff} and not exists ( select 1 from merchant_aftercare_response resp where resp.refund_application_id = r.id and resp.decision in ('AGREE', 'REJECT') ) order by r.id asc limit 200
